## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] RED test now passes (GREEN transition) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-remediation.sh
- [ ] Approach-proposer RED test still passes (cross-agent dd-4 sanity) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-approach-proposer-remediation.sh
- [ ] Agent file contains the literal DELTA OUTPUT MODE token — Verify: grep -qF '=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] Inputs section contains the optional Remediation Context subsection — Verify: grep -qE '^### Remediation Context \(optional\)' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub includes EVIDENCE FROM format and pre-generation Read gate
- [ ] DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub includes all three TDD-preservation invariants (RED-before-GREEN, depends_on, testing_mode)
- [ ] DELTA OUTPUT MODE stub references protocol doc and Schema Preservation — task-decomposer sub-section
- [ ] Agent model directive remains opus
- [ ] Pre-existing output schema still documented (task_drafts, dd_partition_map)
